items.title: ‘When Greed Is Good,’ Says Top Investor About Micron Stock
items.summary: Micron’s (NASDAQ:MU) business and its share price have been going opposite ways for months. AI servers still take every memory chip the company can make, and its latest quarter beat Wall Street’s forecasts. Investors aren’t sure how long that can last, though, and the stock has been falling since the summer. The midterms added to the pressure.
